title: Circulating Inflammatory Cytokines and Female Reproductive Diseases: A Mendelian Randomization Analysis.
exposure_dataset: Bouras et al. cytokine GWAS meta-analysis (Finnish NFBC1966/YFS/FINRISK + SCALLOP + INTERVAL; up to 31,112 Europeans; 47 cytokines). Instruments: cis-pQTL (main) and cis-eQTL, 'a selection of them was provided by Bouras et al' (Lin Table S2, Figshare). Replication: Folkersen 2020 (30,931 Europeans) cis-pQTL.
cis_window_note: Only 'mapping to the vicinity of the gene unit'; the 500 kb window applies to colocalisation, not instrument selection.
other_filters: F-statistic and R2 computed per instrument; no cut-off stated
PhenoScanner: IVs associated with confounders removed and MR re-run (sensitivity)
MR-PRESSO, weighted median, contamination mixture, MR-Egger as sensitivity
12 of 47 cytokines lacked instruments; 31 analysed under cis-pQTL, 27 under cis-eQTL
harmonisation_tool: Not described; packages named: TwoSampleMR (weighted median), MendelianRandomization (contamination mixture), MR-PRESSO

inherited_rules.source: Bouras E et al. BMC Med 2022;20:3 (doi:10.1186/s12916-021-02193-0; PMC8750876), Methods 'Cytokine instrument selection'; NOT stated in Lin
inherited_rules.cis_pqtl_rule: variants within gene locus +/-500 kb (hg19, UCSC) associated with the cytokine at P<1e-4
inherited_rules.cis_eqtl_rule: gene +/-500 kb; expression (GTEx v8, aggregated across tissues) P<1e-4 and cytokine P<0.05
inherited_rules.mcsf_check: Bouras Table 1: MCSF/CSF1 cis-pQTL 13 SNPs, r2 0.049, matching Lin Table 1 (13, R2 0.0493)

source_location: Materials and Methods > 'Cytokine Instrument Selection'; 'Two-Sample MR Analysis and Sensitivity Analyses'; 'Replication Analysis'; Results Table 1 (publisher HTML via WebFetch; summarised, not verbatim).
instruments_listed: Lin Table S2 (Figshare https://figshare.com/s/579ca12f80d5723e1987), not available locally; Bouras Additional file 2 Table S2 may list them.

per_claim.claim_notes: Table 1: nSNP 13, R2 0.0493, F 805.34, OR 1.26 (1.14-1.39), FDR 7.93e-4. Replication with Folkersen 2020 cis-pQTL: 2 SNPs; text OR 1.214 vs Table 2 OR 1.01.

rederivable_reason: Lin states no P threshold, window or clumping and uses Bouras's pooled meta-analysis. Following Bouras's own rule (+/-500 kb, P<1e-4, MAF>=0.05, r2<0.1) could rebuild the 13 SNPs only if those pooled summary statistics are accessible.
notes: All instrument rules are deferred to Bouras et al.; inherited_rules come from Bouras 2022, not Lin. Lin read from publisher HTML via a summarising fetch, so wording is not verbatim. Replication OR inconsistent between text and Table 2.
